article.title: Reinforcing the imperialist drive
article.author: Prabhat Patnaik
article.content: The capitalist system cannot experience sustained growth in the absence of an exogenous stimulus, that is a stimulus arising from outside the process of growth itself. The post Reinforcing the imperialist drive appeared first on MR Online .
